mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession fears.
regime_hint: monetary easing amid labor market weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), the manufacturing sector slowdown signals a broad economic downturn, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
